_source: film_titles where seen_before and no film_log row -- re-pulled 2026-08-13 from swjqlfcqvcrnydpyjyog after two DB repairs: the duplicate bare 'The Prestige' row was deleted (it was referenced by nothing), and the six rows with no poster_path were filled in. Nope / Old / The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo got their real TMDB records. The four franchise-or-run rows have NO single film behind them, so each carries the poster of the entry that stands for the run -- Bond: Casino Royale (2006), Bourne: The Bourne Identity (2002), LOTR: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001), Apes: Rise of the Planet of the Apes (2011). Deliberately still no runtime or director on those four: the row is a run, and one film's credits would be a lie. seen_note stays RAW -- emit_vault_data.py parses 'memory N.N' out of it to split the Shoebox from the Dark Drawer. Do not pre-parse here; the note is the evidence, the split is code.
